newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK ONE-YR BOND AVERAGE YIELD RISES TO 14.88PCT.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK ONE-YR BOND AVERAGE YIELD RISES TO 14.88PCT.

text.p: Average yield at an auction of one-year state bonds on Tuesday rose to 14.88 percent, from 14.66 percent in the last successful auction of similar bonds on February 25, the central bank said in a statement.

The statement said the finance ministry accepted bids worth 2.04 billion crowns, out of a total of 4.09 billion. Ministry officials were not immediately available for comment on the results of the auction.
The paper carries a fixed annual coupon of 10.00 percent.
